clips.title: The story
paras: The Ivar Patch is a blighted pumpkin farm located in northern Silverpine Forest. Once a thriving agricultural homestead of Lordaeron, its residents were wiped out during the Third War and transformed into ravenous, mindlessly hostile ghouls.

Before the Third War swept through Lordaeron, this pumpkin patch was a prosperous homestead owned by a farmer named Ivar, who employed a lively crew of farmhands and servants. When the Scourge unleashed the Plague of Undeath across the countryside, the farm was consumed completely. Rather than rising with their minds intact like the free-willed Forsaken, Ivar, his family, and his laborers were reduced to rotting, feral ghouls bound to prowl the ruined soil.
